text_en: How beautiful you are, my love, how very beautiful! Your eyes are doves behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats, moving down the slopes of Gilead.
text_cn: 我的爱卿，你多么美丽！你多么美丽！你的两眼隐在面纱后， 有如一对鸽眼；你的头发犹如由基肋阿得山下来的一群山羊。

text_en: Your teeth are like a flock of shorn ewes that have come up from the washing, all of which bear twins, and not one among them is bereaved.
text_cn: 你的牙齿像一群剪毛后洗洁上来的母绵羊，都怀有双胎，没有不生育的。

text_en: Your lips are like a crimson thread, and your mouth is lovely. Your cheeks are like halves of a pomegranate behind your veil.
text_cn: 你的嘴唇像一缕朱红线，你的小口娇美可爱；你隐在面纱后的两颊，有如分裂两半的石榴。

text_en: Your neck is like the tower of David, built in courses; on it hang a thousand bucklers, all of them shields of warriors.
text_cn: 你的颈项宛如达味的宝塔， 建筑如堡垒，悬有上千的盾牌，都是武士的利器。

text_en: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle, that feed among the lilies.
text_cn: 你的两个乳房，好似母羚羊的一对孪生小羚羊，牧放在百合花中。

text_en: Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, I will hasten to the mountain of myrrh and the hill of frankincense.
text_cn: 趁晚风还未生凉，日影还未消失，我要到没药山，上乳香岭。

text_en: You are altogether beautiful, my love; there is no flaw in you.
text_cn: 我的爱卿！你是全美的，你毫无瑕疵。

text_en: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride; come with me from Lebanon. Depart from the peak of Amana, from the peak of Senir and Hermon, from the dens of lions, from the mountains of leopards.
text_cn: 你从黎巴嫩下来，我的新娘！从黎巴嫩下来，离开阿玛纳山巅，色尼尔和赫尔孟山顶， 狮子的巢穴，豹子的山岗。

text_en: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride, you have ravished my heart with a glance of your eyes, with one jewel of your necklace.
text_cn: 我的妹妺，我的新娘，你夺去了我的心！你回目一顾，你项链上的一颗珍珠，夺去了我的心。

text_en: How sweet is your love, my sister, my bride! how much better is your love than wine, and the fragrance of your oils than any spice!
text_cn: 我的妹妺，我的新娘！你的爱抚多么甘甜，你的爱抚甜过美酒，你香液的芬芳超越一切香料。

text_en: Your lips distill nectar, my bride; honey and milk are under your tongue; the scent of your garments is like the scent of Lebanon.
text_cn: 我的新娘！你的嘴唇滴流纯蜜，你的舌下有蜜有奶；你衣服的芬芳好似乳香。

text_en: A garden locked is my sister, my bride, a garden locked, a fountain sealed.
text_cn: 我的妹妹，我的新娘！是关闭的花园，是一座关锁的花园，是一个封锁的泉源。

text_en: Your channel is an orchard of pomegranates with all choicest fruits, henna with nard,
text_cn: 你吐苗萌芽，形成了石榴园，内有各种珍奇的果木：凤仙和玫瑰，

text_en: nard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense, myrrh and aloes, with all chief spices—
text_cn: 甘松和番红，丁香和肉桂，各种乳香树，没药和芦荟，以及各种奇香异草。

text_en: a garden fountain, a well of living water, and flowing streams from Lebanon.
text_cn: 你是涌出的水泉，是从黎巴嫩流下的活水泉。

text_en: Awake, O north wind, and come, O south wind! Blow upon my garden that its fragrance may be wafted abroad. Let my beloved come to his garden, and eat its choicest fruits.
text_cn: 北风，吹来！南风，吹来！吹向我的花园，使它的清香四溢。愿我的爱人进入他的花园，品尝其中的佳果！
